title: The Magic Key
purpose: Explore testable meta-properties of JSON as a constraint-defined, reversible, self-describing but non-self-executing research object, including representation effects on AI systems.
new_findings: JSON anatomy frozen in Russian with strict separation of base syntax from external semantic layers.
First arXiv sweep links formal JSON models, JSON Schema logic/witness generation and structured-output LLM behavior.
High-value external signal: schema key wording can act as an instruction channel for LLM structured generation.
High-value external signal: JSON response register can change model answer distributions.
Boundary retained: schema-valid or structurally-valid does not imply semantic truth or authority.
algorithmic_spine: TOPA/Spider discovery + SEARCH_GRAMMAR + REPRESENTATION_GRAMMAR + INTERFACE_GRAMMAR + declarative Pippi/Keymaster/M2R-style key selection
safety_boundary: JSON is data; activation is interpreted by an external allowlisted deterministic interpreter and fails closed.
next_gate: Citation-graph expansion + exact MAGIC_KEY prototype over frozen JSON fixtures + independent replication of schema-key and format-register effects.
